trafficGated: This tool depends on traffic capture. Turn on traffic capture in System settings first before it can be bound to agents and enabled.
bindAgents: Bind agents (decides which agents get this tool)
paramsLabel: Parameters (name / type / required are read-only; description and default can be edited)
title: Tools
subtitle: Descriptions and bindings for system tools, plus custom tools (command / script / http)
systemMatched: {shown} / {total} matches. Click a card to edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
systemTotal: {total} in total. Click a card to edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
noSystem: (no system tools yet, waiting for backend seed)
customMatched: shell/command/script/http, {shown} / {total} matches. Click a card to edit
customTotal: shell (bash declaration) / command (command) / script (Python) / http (API), {total} in total. Click a card to edit
noCustom: (no custom tools yet. Click "New custom tool" at the top right)
editSheetDesc: Edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
keyInvalid: The key must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores
httpSchemaRequired: HTTP tools must provide a parameter JSON Schema (with properties, can't be empty)
customSheetDesc: shell = bash environment declaration (only needs a name and description to tell the model it can call bash); command / script / http require an execution spec.
shellHint: Suited to well-known tools such as nmap, sqlmap and ffuf: the model already knows how to use them, so you only need to declare that it "can be called from bash". The name and description are appended to the Bash tool description.
pythonBody: Python body (arguments come via stdin JSON / os.environ["TOOL_X"])
schemaHttp: (required for http tools; must include properties)
deferredHint: deferred (enable only for large sets of rarely used tools)
testRun: Test run (uses the current form, nothing is saved)
